alloy: all s: Spec | (some v: Unit | cites[s, v] and v not in Axiom and v not in Spec and v not in Fact) implies s in Misnesting
all e: Exception | (some v: Unit | cites[e, v] and v not in Spec and v not in Fact) implies e in Misnesting
all b: Bug | (some v: Unit | cites[b, v] and v not in Spec) implies b in Misnesting
all c: Conflict | hidden[c] implies c in Finding
some Tracker implies (all c: Conflict | (no i: Issue | c->i in Name.issue) implies c in Untracking)
all c: Conflict | (some i: Issue | c->i in Name.issue and i not in Known) implies c in Mistracking
all t: Declared | (no g: Tag | t->g in Carry.rel) implies t in Uncitation
all t: Declared | (some u: Unit | checks[t, u] and u not in Claim) implies t in Misaiming
all t: Test | (some c: Claim | checks[t, c] and refined[c]) implies t in Overreach
all f: Fence | f not in Languaged implies (no u: Unit | u->f in Blocks.rel)
all f: Fence | f in VocabularyWord implies f in VocabularyBlock
all f: Fence | f in BoundsWord implies f in BoundsBlock

all r: Run | ((some f: Frontmatter, p: Missing | lists[f, p]) or (some Unreadable) or (some c: Command | r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) or (some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2)) implies r in Exits2
doubt: The first two disjuncts (a frontmatter listing a missing plugin; checker reporting an unreadable frontmatter) are not grammatically tied to "the run", so I read them as global conditions rather than conditions about the run's own documents.

alloy: (all p: Plugin, d: Document | applies[p, d] implies p->d in Over.rel) and (all p: Plugin, d: Document | (not applies[p, d] and p->d in Over.rel) implies d in Given)
all p: Plugin, d: Document | ((no f: Listing | d->f in Head.rel) and d not in Given) implies p->d not in Over.rel
all f: Unterminated | f in Refused
all f: Doubled | f in Refused
all f: Dangling | f in Refused
all r: Run, c: Command | (r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) implies (c in Unknown and r in Exits2)
all r: Run, c: Command | (r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) implies c in Unknown
all r: Run, c: Command | (r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) implies r in Exits2
all command_1: Command | available[command_1] implies command_1 not in Unknown
some b: Bug, i: Issue, t: ExpectedFailure | b->i in Name.issue and i in Known and i not in Closed and checks[t, b] and b not in Finding and t not in Finding
some c: Conflict, a, b: Unit, i: Issue | a != b and c->a in Name.between and c->b in Name.between and c->i in Name.issue and i in Known and i not in Closed and c not in Finding

some document_1, document_2, document_3: Document | document_1 != document_3 and document_1->document_2 in Extend.rel and document_2->document_3 in Extend.rel and document_1->document_3 in Context.rel
doubt: Context.rel reads "{2} is context for {1}"; I took the stored pair to be (document in question, its context), i.e. document_1->document_3 in Context.rel for "document_3 is context for document_1", keeping argument order by numbering rather than grammar.

alloy: all u: Unit | u in Wordless implies u in Unsayable
all u: Unit | u in Twofold implies u in Unsayable
all u: Unit | u in Unsayable implies u in Explained
all r: Run, u: Unit | (r->GenerateCommand in Ask.rel and u in Handwritten) implies (u in Reported and r not in Exits0)
all r: Run | r->GenerateCommand in Ask.rel implies ((all u: Unsayable | u in Explained) and (some Unsayable implies r not in Exits0))
all word_1: Word | ((some unit_1: Unit | unit_1->word_1 in Voice.rel) and (no u: Unit | u->word_1 in Introduce.rel)) implies word_1 in Undeclared

all document_1, document_2: Document, unit_1, unit_2: Unit, word_1: Word | (document_1->document_2 in Context.rel and document_1->unit_1 in Hold.units and unit_1->word_1 in Voice.rel and document_2->unit_2 in Hold.units and unit_2->word_1 in Introduce.rel) implies word_1 not in Undeclared
doubt: Same Context.rel argument-order reading as s112-cur: document_1->document_2 in Context.rel for "document_2 is context for document_1".

alloy: (all u: Contradicting | u in Named) and (all s: Impossible | s in Raised)
all u: Unit | u in BareFormula implies u in Held
all u: Unit | u in Contradicting implies u in Named
all u: Unit | u in Contradicting implies (all v: Unit | v->u in Together.rel implies v in Named)
all unit_1, unit_2: Unit | unit_1->unit_2 in Share.rel implies unit_1->unit_2 in Together.rel
all unit_1, unit_2: Unit, word: Word | (unit_1 != unit_2 and unit_2->word in Utter.rel) implies unit_1->word not in Expose.rel
all u: Unit, word: Word | u->word in Picture.rel implies (no v: Unit | v->word in Expose.rel)

all document_1, document_2: Document, unit_1, unit_2: Unit, word: Word | (document_1->document_2 in Context.rel and document_1->unit_1 in Hold.units and document_2->unit_2 in Hold.units and unit_2->word in Utter.rel) implies unit_1->word not in Expose.rel
doubt: Same Context.rel argument-order reading as s112-cur/s146-s.

alloy: all d: Definition | (d in GuardedByKind and byKind[d]) implies d in PhrasePerKind
all d: Definition | (d in SameKindTwice and byKind[d]) implies d in JoinedWithOr
all definition_1: Definition | (definition_1 in OrInsideKind and byKind[definition_1]) implies definition_1 in OneCoordination
all q: Quantifier | q in NoWithAnother implies q in InFull
all q: Quantifier | q in TimedCondition implies q in InFull
all quantifier_1: Quantifier | quantifier_1 in ConditionAside implies quantifier_1 in InFull
all l: Series | (l in OneLineRule and l not in TimeFirst and l in TimeSecond) implies l in KeepsThen

all l: Series | (l in Rule and l in TimeFirst) implies l in ThenOwnLine

some l: Series | l in Many and l in SharedSubject
